_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: Minecraft: Travertine
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Travertine, PaperMC's Waterfall fork that also lets Minecraft 1.7 players join, a proxy that links servers into one network. PaperMC no longer develops it.
startup: mkdir -p plugins/bStats; b=plugins/bStats/config.yml; touch $b; if ! grep -q "^serverUuid:" $b; then read -r u < /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid; echo "serverUuid: \"$u\"" >> $b; fi; grep -q "^logFailedRequests:" $b || echo "logFailedRequests: false" >> $b; if grep -q "^enabled:" $b; then sed -i "s/^enabled:.*/enabled: {{BSTATS}}/" $b; else echo "enabled: {{BSTATS}}" >> $b; fi; read -r need 2>/dev/null < .raptor-java || need=8; java -version 2>&1 | awk -F'"' -v need="$need" '/version/ { split($2, v, "."); have = (v[1] == "1") ? v[2] : v[1]; if (have + 0 < need + 0) { printf "This server needs Java %s or newer, and it runs Java %s. Choose Java %s in Startup, then start the server again.\n", need, have, need; exit 1 } exit }' && exec java -Xms128M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=85.0 -XX:+IgnoreUnrecognizedVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=4M -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled -XX:MaxInlineLevel=15 -Dterminal.jline=false -Dterminal.ansi=true -jar {{SERVER_JARFILE}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Minecraft: Travertine. Downloads the chosen Travertine build from PaperMC and
# checks it against PaperMC's checksum. Settings and plugins are never
# touched, and the jar is only replaced once the new one checks out.
project=travertine
name=Travertine
jar="${SERVER_JARFILE:-travertine.jar}"
want_version="${MINECRAFT_VERSION:-latest}"
custom_url="${DL_LINK:-}"
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
get() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" "$1"; }
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
sum() { "${1}sum" "$2" | cut -d' ' -f1; }
trap 'rm -f "$jar.new"; echo "The install stopped at line $LINENO of its script. Reinstall to try again."' ERR

# install_jar <url> <md5|sha1|sha256|sha512|none> <hash> <what>: skipped
# when the jar already matches; replaced only once the new one checks out.
install_jar() {
    if [ "$2" != none ] && [ -f "$jar" ] && [ "$(sum "$2" "$jar")" = "$3" ]; then
        echo "$4 is already installed."
        return
    fi
    echo "Downloading $4"
    curl -fsSLg --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$jar.new" "$1" || { rm -f "$jar.new"; fail "The download failed. Reinstall to try again."; }
    if [ "$2" != none ] && [ "$(sum "$2" "$jar.new")" != "$3" ]; then
        rm -f "$jar.new"
        fail "The download didn't match its checksum. Reinstall to try again."
    fi
    unzip -tq "$jar.new" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { rm -f "$jar.new"; fail "The download isn't a valid jar. Reinstall to try again."; }
    mv -f "$jar.new" "$jar"
}

# The Java the jar needs, from its main class: the startup command checks it.
jar_java() {
    local main major
    main=$(unzip -p "$jar" META-INF/MANIFEST.MF 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' | sed -n 's/^Main-Class: *//p' | head -n1) || true
    major=$(unzip -p "$jar" "${main//.//}.class" 2>/dev/null | od -An -j6 -N2 -tu1 | awk 'NF == 2 { print $1 * 256 + $2 - 44 }') || true
    echo "${major:-8}"
}

api="https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/$project"
if [ -n "${custom_url:-}" ]; then
    install_jar "$custom_url" none "" "the server jar from the download link"
    jar_java > .raptor-java
    echo "Installed the jar from the download link. It needs Java $(cat .raptor-java) or newer."
    exit 0
fi

versions=$(get "$api/versions") || fail "PaperMC can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
version="${want_version:-latest}"
build="${BUILD_NUMBER:-latest}"
stable() { get "$api/versions/$1/builds?channel=STABLE" | jq -c '.[0] // empty'; }
if [ "$version" = latest ]; then
    # The newest version PaperMC still supports with a stable build, or,
    # for a project it no longer develops, its newest one.
    build_json=""
    for v in $(jq -r '(.versions | map(select(.version.support.status == "SUPPORTED"))) as $s | (if ($s | length) > 0 then $s else .versions end)[] | .version.id' <<<"$versions"); do
        if [ "$build" = latest ]; then
            build_json=$(stable "$v") || true
        else
            build_json=$(get "$api/versions/$v/builds/$build" 2>/dev/null) || true
        fi
        if [ -n "$build_json" ]; then version=$v; break; fi
    done
    [ -n "$build_json" ] || fail "PaperMC has no stable $name build to install right now. Reinstall to try again later."
else
    jq -e --arg v "$version" 'any(.versions[]; .version.id == $v)' <<<"$versions" >/dev/null ||
        fail "$name has no version $version. Set Version to latest, or to one $name has, such as $(jq -r '.versions[0].version.id' <<<"$versions")."
    if [ "$build" = latest ]; then
        build_json=$(stable "$version") || true
        if [ -z "$build_json" ]; then
            build_json=$(get "$api/versions/$version/builds/latest") || fail "PaperMC can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
            echo "$name $version has no stable build, so this is an experimental one."
        fi
    else
        build_json=$(get "$api/versions/$version/builds/$build" 2>/dev/null) ||
            fail "$name has no build $build for version $version. Set Build to latest, or to one of its builds."
    fi
fi

id=$(jq -r '.id' <<<"$build_json")
dl=$(jq -c '.downloads."server:default" // .downloads.application // empty' <<<"$build_json")
[ -n "$dl" ] || fail "$name $version build $id has no server jar. Choose another build."
url=$(jq -r .url <<<"$dl")
sha=$(jq -r .checksums.sha256 <<<"$dl")
java=$(jq -r --arg v "$version" '.versions[] | select(.version.id == $v) | .version.java.version.minimum // 8' <<<"$versions")
install_jar "$url" sha256 "$sha" "$name $version build $id"
echo "$java" > .raptor-java
# Waterfall's and Travertine's commands (glist, send, alert...) are modules
# they'd download from a link PaperMC has retired, so they come from here.
while IFS=$'\t' read -r mod murl msha; do
    mkdir -p modules
    if [ -f "modules/$mod.jar" ] && [ "$(sum sha256 "modules/$mod.jar")" = "$msha" ]; then continue; fi
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "modules/$mod.jar.new" "$murl"
    [ "$(sum sha256 "modules/$mod.jar.new")" = "$msha" ] || { rm -f "modules/$mod.jar.new"; fail "The $mod module didn't match PaperMC's checksum. Reinstall to try again."; }
    mv -f "modules/$mod.jar.new" "modules/$mod.jar"
done < <(jq -r '.downloads | to_entries[] | select(.key | startswith("module:")) | [(.key | ltrimstr("module:")), .value.url, .value.checksums.sha256] | @tsv' <<<"$build_json")
echo "Installed $name $version build $id. It needs Java $java or newer."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Travertine version, such as 1.21, or latest for its newest. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Build
variables.description: The Travertine build for that version, or latest for its newest stable build.

variables.name: Jar file
variables.description: The name of the server's jar file.

variables.name: Download link
variables.description: A link to download the server jar from instead of PaperMC, which only staff can set.

variables.name: Usage statistics
variables.description: Send anonymous statistics about the proxy and its plugins to bStats.org, where plugin authors see them (true or false).
